d:
The Agniveer scheme is back in the spotlight after the government announced a major change to the Agnipath recruitment framework. Under the revised arrangement, Agniveers completing their initial four-year service will have an option to serve for two additional years, opening another opportunity to join the regular cadre of the armed forces.
But why are some Agniveers unhappy with this decision? Why are they demanding jobs instead of an extension? And what happens to the employment opportunities and reservations they were promised when they joined the armed forces?
